day: # Alternative readings of the Consultation on Common Texts, "Addressing Anti-Judaism
# during Lent and Eastertide" (April 8, 2025; updated April 21, 2026), as a set of its
# own beside the Revised Common Lectionary's, from Easter 2025 (church year 2024) on:
#   - Good Friday: John 19:1-42 or Mark 14:1-15:47 for the Gospel; in Year B
#     Mark is read on Good Friday
offset: John (18:1-40) 19:1-42 or Mark on Palm/Passion Sunday.

day: #   - The Easter season, Easter Day to Pentecost with the Ascension: a reading from
#     the Hebrew Scriptures and a psalm in place of the first reading from Acts and
#     its psalm (the Epistle and Gospel stay).
#   - After Pentecost: readings from Acts in place of the Epistle, Propers 20-26 in
#     Year A (Peter), Propers 10-16 in Years B (early disciples) and C (Paul).
# The 2026 update has Ezekiel 43:1-7a on the Sixth Sunday of Easter, Year A.
